45:2: The sending down of the Book is from Allah, the al-Aziz, the al-Hakim.
45:3: Undoubtedly, in the heavens and the earth there are signs for the believers.
45:4: In your creation and in every living creature He scatters, there are signs for a people who believe with certainty.
45:5: In the succession of the night and the day, in Allah's sending down provision from the sky and reviving the earth with it after its death, and in the directing of the winds, there are signs for a people who reflect.
45:6: These are the signs of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then after Allah and His signs, what statement will they believe?
45:8: He hears the signs of Allah being recited to him, then he persists in arrogance as if he had not heard them. So give him good tidings of a painful punishment.
45:9: When he knows anything of Our signs, he takes it in mockery. For those, there is a humiliating punishment.
45:10: Behind them is Hell. Nothing of what they earned will benefit them, nor the protectors they took besides Allah. And for them is a great punishment.
45:11: This is a guidance; and for those who deny the signs of their Rabb, there is a very painful punishment.
45:12: Allah is the One who subjected the sea for you, that ships may sail in it by His command, and that you may seek of His bounty, and that you may give thanks.
45:13: He subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, all from Himself. Undoubtedly, in this there are signs for a people who reflect.
45:14: Say to those who believe: Let them forgive those who do not hope for the days of Allah, so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
45:15: Whoever does a righteous deed, it is for himself, and whoever does evil, it is against himself; then to your Rabb you will be returned.
45:16: And certainly, We gave the Children of Israel the Book, the judgement, and the prophethood, and We provided them with clean things and We favored them over the worlds.
45:17: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter. Yet they did not differ until after knowledge came to them, out of insolence among themselves. Undoubtedly, your Rabb will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.
45:18: Then We placed you upon a shariah of the matter; so follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.
45:19: Undoubtedly, they can avail you nothing against Allah. Undoubtedly, the wrongdoers are protectors of one another, while Allah is the protector of the people of taqwa.
45:20: This is clear insights for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe with certainty.
45:21: Or did those who commit evil deeds think that We would make them like those who believe and do righteous deeds, equal in their life and their death? How evil is what they judge!
45:22: Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth, so that every soul may be recompensed for what it earned, and they will not be wronged.
45:23: Have you seen him who took his desire as his god? Allah led him astray upon knowledge, sealed his hearing and his heart, and placed a veil over his eye. Who will guide him after Allah? Will you not reflect?
45:24: And they said: 'It is nothing but our worldly life; we die and we live, and nothing destroys us except time.' They have no knowledge of this; they do but conjecture.
45:25: When Our signs are recited to them clearly, their argument was nothing but that they said: 'Bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful!'
45:26: Say: 'Allah gives you life, then He causes you to die, then He will gather you to the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know.'
45:27: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah, and on the day that the Hour strikes, on that day the followers of falsehood will be in loss.
45:28: You will see every community kneeling. Every community will be summoned to its book. Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
45:29: This is Our book speaking against you with truth. Undoubtedly, We were recording what you used to do.
45:30: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Rabb will admit them into His mercy; that is the clear triumph.
45:31: And as for those who disbelieved: 'Were not My signs recited to you? But you were arrogant and became a guilty people.'
45:32: And when it was said: 'The promise of Allah is true and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming,' you said: 'We do not know what the Hour is, we only conjecture, and we are not convinced.'
45:33: The evils of what they did appeared to them, and that which they used to mock enveloped them.
45:34: And it will be said: 'Today We forget you, just as you forgot the meeting of this day of yours. Your refuge is the Fire, and there are no helpers for you.'
45:35: This is because you took the signs of Allah in mockery and the worldly life deceived you. Today they will not be taken out from it, nor will excuses be accepted from them.
45:36: Praise belongs to Allah, Rabb of the heavens, Rabb of the earth, and Rabb of the worlds.
45:37: Greatness in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him, and He is al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
